blocks.text: Species biological classification (jandaron ki darja-bandi) ki bunyadi ikai hai. Is se murad hai “jandaron ka aisa group jin ki jismani aur genetic khasiyatein milti julti hon aur, sab se ahem baat, jo aapas mein mil kar (interbreed kar ke) aise bachche paida kar saken jo khud bhi bachche paida kar saken (fertile offspring)”. Maslan Indus River Dolphin ek alag species hai. Tamam Indus dolphins aapas mein nasl barha sakti hain, lekin doosri qism ki dolphins ke saath mil kar fertile bachche paida nahin kar saktin.

Population ek hi species ke un afraad ka group hai jo ek hi waqt mein ek hi jughrafiyai ilaqe mein rehte hain. Species poori duniya mein jandaron ki ek “qism” ko kehte hain, jabke population kisi khaas jagah ke khaas group ko. Maslan Chitral Gol National Park mein rehne wale tamam Markhor mil kar ek population hain. Agar hum poore Pakistan ke Markhoron ki baat karein to yeh species ki baat hai; agar sirf Chitral ke Markhoron ki baat karein to yeh population ki baat hai.

Qudrat mein koi population akeli nahin rehti. Community un tamam mukhtalif species ki populations ka majmooa hai jo ek hi ilaqe mein reh kar aapas mein ta'alluq rakhti hain. Is mein paude, janwar, fungi aur bacteria sab shamil hain. Maslan Karachi ka Mangrove Forest ek community hai jis mein mangrove ke darakht, mudskipper machhli, kekre (crabs) aur mukhtalif sahili parinde (shorebirds) shamil hain. Yeh sab ek hi jagah mein rehte aur ek doosre se ta'alluq rakhte hain (maslan parinde machhli khate hain).

Communities ecosystems mein rehti hain. Ecosystem mahol ke biotic (zinda) hisson aur abiotic (be-jaan) hisson, jaise dhoop, mitti, paani aur hawa, se mil kar banta hai. Ecosystem mein tawanai (energy) sirf ek simt mein behti hai (unidirectional), jabke ghizai ajza (nutrients) zinda aur be-jaan hisson ke darmiyan chakkar lagate rehte hain.

Maslan Thar Desert (registan) ek bohat bara ecosystem hai. Is mein sirf saanp, kaale hiran (blackbucks) aur jhaariyan (community) hi nahin, balke jhulsa dene wali garmi, jagah badalte ret ke teele aur kabhi kabhar ki barish (abiotic factors) bhi hain jo wahan rehne wale jandaron ke rehne sehne par asar dalte hain.

Biome ek bara aur alag pehchan wala jughrafiyai ilaqa hai jis ki pehchan us ki khaas aab-o-hawa (climate), mitti, oonchai (altitude) aur un halaat ke mutabiq dhale hue paudon aur janwaron ki qismon se hoti hai.

Pakistan ka mukhtalif jughrafiya kai biomes banata hai. Maslan Coniferous Forest Biome Murree aur Swat ke oonche ilaqon mein hai, jahan sakht sardiyan aur cheer/pine ke darakht zyada hain. Desert Biome Thal aur Thar ke ilaqon mein hai, jahan barish kam hoti hai aur cacti jaise khaas "succulent" (pani jama karne wale moti patton/tanon wale) paude milte hain. Isi tarah Freshwater Biomes mein Indus River ka bara nizam shamil hai.

Biosphere ecological organization ka sab se ooncha aur sab ko shamil karne wala level hai. Yeh duniya ke tamam biomes ka majmooa hai. Is se murad zameen ka har woh hissa hai jahan zindagi maujood hai: Arabian Sea ki sab se gehri khaiyon (trenches) se le kar Himalaya ki sab se oonchi chotiyon tak, balke hawa mein kai kilometre oopar tak.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Biosphere ko aksar "Global Ecosystem" (aalami ecosystem) kaha jata hai. Yeh zameen ke gird ek patla "ghilaf" (envelope) hai jahan lithosphere (khushki), hydrosphere (paani) aur atmosphere (hawa) mil kar zindagi ko sahara dete hain.

blocks.alt: Chhe jure hue hexagon. 1. Species: aik Indus River dolphin. 2. Population: kai Indus dolphins. 3. Community: talaab mein dolphins, machhliyan aur bagla. 4. Ecosystem: suraj, badal, pahar aur darya ki wadi, energy flow aur nutrient cycling ke teeron ke saath. 5. Biome: Pakistan ka naqsha, coniferous jangal (Swat), registan (Thar) aur riverine (Indus) ilaqe. 6. Biosphere: zameen ka gola, atmosphere, lithosphere aur hydrosphere.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Is khaake mein kitab ke chhe hexagon phone par parhne ke liye do-do ki qataron mein rakhe gaye hain; teer phir bhi 1 se 6 tak usi tarteeb se jaate hain: species (aik dolphin) se population (kai dolphins), community (kai qismein), ecosystem (jandar + be-jaan mahol), biome (aab-o-hawa wala bara ilaqa) aur biosphere (poori zameen ki zindagi).

blocks.prompt: ‘Pakistan ke tamam Markhor’ species kehlayenge ya population?
blocks.explanation: Kitab ke mutabiq poore Pakistan ke Markhoron ki baat species ki baat hai, jabke kisi ek ilaqe (jaise Chitral Gol National Park) ke Markhor ek population hain.

items: Tarteeb: species → population → community → ecosystem → biome → biosphere.
Species: aapas mein fertile bachche paida karne wale milte julte jandar (Indus River Dolphin). Population: ek ilaqe mein ek species (Chitral Gol ke Markhor).
Community: ek ilaqe ki tamam populations; ecosystem = community + be-jaan mahol (tawanai ek simt mein, nutrients chakkar mein).
Biome: khaas aab-o-hawa wala bara ilaqa (Murree/Swat ke conifer jangal, Thal/Thar registan); biosphere: zameen par zindagi wali har jagah.
